mechanism.cause: The inherited v1.2.1 product entrypoint checked its canonical environment before the Link-92 configure callback ran. With the environment and DRIVER still carrying their inherited values, it re-executed the v1.3 Link-84 wrapper; that wrapper correctly rejected the v1.4 profile as foreign freight.
mechanism.failed_boundary: inherited entrypoint environment bootstrap before product build directory creation
mechanism.permanent_closer: The Link-92 startup gate requires the canonical environment and all release/link/build/manifest/driver/configure bindings before P.main. A missing-environment mutation must fail.

claim_limit: Host entrypoint-bootstrap First Red only. No product, linker, geometry, media, device, Link-92 or release claim.
